startersHint: A starter sets the look of every box. You can change the look under More options.
pickHint: A video from your phone or computer, up to {max} MB. It is not uploaded.
sampleNote: Makes a short made-up video with a cartoon face and a car with a made-up number plate, and puts boxes on both.
fileFailed: This video could not be opened here. Try an MP4 from your phone.
tooBig: This video is bigger than {max} MB. Cut it shorter first with the Video Compressor and Trimmer.
previewLabel: Your video with the boxes on it
boxesTitle: 3. Put a box over each thing to hide
boxesHint: Tap Add a box, then drag the box onto the face or plate and drag its corner to make it bigger. Play the video to check where it needs to be.
maxBoxes: You can add up to {max} boxes.
movesHint: Drag the dashed box to where the thing is at the end. The box slides there between the start and end times.
noBoxes: No boxes yet. Tap Add a box.
check: Show the effect on this frame
checkHint: Pause the video, then tap to see the hiding on that picture before you make the whole video.
checkLabel: This frame with the boxes applied
strengthHint: Strong turns the box into a few large blocks, so faces and numbers cannot be made out. Choose Black box when nothing may show.
keepSoundHint: Switch off for a silent video, for example when voices must not be heard either.
make: Hide them and make the video
noBoxesToMake: Add at least one box first.
noMake: This browser cannot make a video. Try a recent Chrome, Edge or Safari.
slowNote: This browser makes the video while it plays, so it takes as long as the video itself. Keep this page open.
keepOpen: Making the video. Keep this page open.
keepOpenSmooth: Making the video, {done}% done, about {left} seconds left. Keep this page open.
failed: The video could not be made. Try a shorter video or a smaller picture size.
tooLong: Only the first {max} minutes are used.
checkResult: Play the whole video once and watch that every box stays on its target before you share it.
notSaved: The video and the boxes are not saved or uploaded. Only the look you chose is remembered on this device.
